user.title: Add server
user.description:
Connection details for the Linux server (Debian, Ubuntu or Proxmox VE). Provide either a password or a private key (or both, in which case the key is preferred).

**Pasting a private SSH key**: On the machine that holds the key, print the private key file's contents (e.g. `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` or `cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa`) and paste the **entire text** into the "Private key" field — including the first line `-----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY-----` and the last line `-----END ... PRIVATE KEY-----`. Do not use the `.pub` file, that is the public key. If the key is protected by a passphrase, enter it in the "Passphrase" field, otherwise leave it empty. The matching public key must already be present in the target server's `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` for the given user.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description:
Change address, credentials or sudo settings. **Leave the password, key and passphrase fields empty to keep the stored values.**

If the server's SSH host key changed (e.g. the new IP points to another machine, or the server was reinstalled), its fingerprint is shown and must be confirmed before any credentials are sent.

confirm.title: Reboot {name}
confirm.description:
The server **{name}** needs to be rebooted for installed updates to take effect.

Reason: {reason}

Pressing **Submit** reboots the server now (without installing updates first). Services, containers and – on Proxmox VE – VMs/LXCs are unavailable meanwhile.

The server is checked again after about three minutes; if a reboot is still required then, this notice reappears.
